summary.one_liner: An awesome-list curating open-source macOS applications written in Swift, organized by category from audio and backup to AI tools and window management.
summary.what_it_does: This is a curated link list rather than a single app. It groups open-source Swift macOS apps into categories such as Audio, Backup, Browser, Chat, Local LLM, AI, AI Usage/Status, Database, Development, Editors, Finance, Games, Menubar, Notch App, Screenshot / Screen Recording, Sharing Files, Terminal, Utilities, Video, Wallpaper, and Window Management. Each entry is a one-line description of the app, and some entries mention features such as on-device speech recognition, menu bar presence, or integrations with AI coding agents. The README also includes sponsor-style promotional blurbs at the top, which are not part of the list itself. Some entries are closed-source or paid products, so the list is not strictly limited to open-source software despite its title.
use_cases: Finding open-source macOS apps by category
Browsing Swift code samples for macOS development
Finding local AI, LLM, and voice dictation apps for Mac
Looking for macOS audio, backup, or browser tools
Comparing AI coding agent monitoring apps
notable: Very broad category coverage, from audio and backup to AI agents and window management
Many entries are menu bar apps
Dense section on AI coding agent usage and monitoring tools
Includes on-device voice dictation and local LLM entries
Contents section at the top links to each category
caveats: The README is truncated, so later categories are not fully shown
Not every listed app is open source or free; some entries are paid or closed-source
Entries are one-line descriptions with no install instructions
